title: astrology saturn: the params of scene.play

lit.description: The fraction of its disc that is lit.

side.description: 1 when Saturn is east of the Sun (lit on the right), else -1.

rings.description: The ring tilt seen from Earth: rings-p<t> for a tilt of 0 or more, rings-n<t> below 0, t the nearest of 3, 9, 15, 21, 27 degrees.
